clue.text: How chess is played in general

definitions.meaning: chess pieces move over every part of the chequered surface, square to square
applying to everyone or everything without exception

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for applying universally, and literally describes play on a chessboard.

clue.text: Load caught being put on legendary ship

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece sits on top of the next, so the letter goes above the ship

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth

explanation.surface: A heavy load is caught as it is loaded onto a famous ship of legend.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo is the goods or freight a vessel or vehicle carries, its load.

clue.text: Means to cross London that destroys terraced houses

indicators.note: houses as a verb means contains, so the answer is held within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A new transport link across the capital would bulldoze rows of terraced homes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'houses' looks like the buildings being knocked down, but it is a verb: the run sits across 'destrOYS TERraced'. An Oyster card is the London travel smartcard.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oyster card is the contactless smartcard used to pay fares on London buses and the Tube.

clue.text: Great Western Railway company

definitions.meaning: a celebrated cowboy film: John Ford's 1939 classic starring John Wayne
a British transport group that has run train franchises such as South West Trains

explanation.definitionFit: Stagecoach is both the title of a classic western film and a UK bus and rail operator.

clue.text: Unpleasant type's order to dog

definitions.meaning: a cad or rotter, a person who behaves dishonourably
the command telling a dog to walk close beside its owner's leg

explanation.definitionFit: A heel is a contemptible person, and 'heel!' commands a dog to walk at one's side.

clue.text: Shovel and pick worker's reserved

definitions.meaning: one of the seven dwarfs in Disney's Snow White, who dig in a mine

explanation.definitionFit: Bashful is the shy one of the seven mining dwarfs, and the word means timid or reserved.

clue.text: Roll ball succeeding a great deal

indicators.note: succeeding means coming after, so the roll and ball follow the letter a

parts.note: a bun is a small bread roll
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A bread roll and a ball after it make for a great deal of fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Abundance is a plentiful quantity, a large amount of something.

clue.text: Delight a player that's puzzling? Most solvers have it!

indicators.note: something puzzling is mixed up, so the letters of the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A puzzle-loving player is delighted by the newspaper that most solvers own.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is self-referential: those solving this puzzle are holding the paper it appears in.
explanation.definitionFit: This puzzle was printed in that British newspaper, so most of its solvers are holding a copy.

clue.text: How fortresses tumbled around a series of battles

indicators.note: around means the jumbled letters enclose the letter a
tumbled means fell in disarray, so the letters of how fortresses are jumbled

explanation.surface: An account of how castles fell, wrapped round a sequence of medieval fights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tumbled' rearranges HOW FORTRESSES, and 'around' wraps those letters about A. The Wars of the Roses were fifteenth-century English civil wars between York and Lancaster.
explanation.definitionFit: The Wars of the Roses were a succession of civil-war battles between rival English royal houses.

clue.text: Nasa's speciality quickly harbours love

indicators.note: harbours means shelters within, so the word for quickly holds the love god

parts.note: apace means swiftly
Eros is the Greek god of love

explanation.surface: The space agency's expertise is rapid work that also shelters love.
explanation.definitionFit: Nasa specialises in the science of flight in the atmosphere and outer space.

clue.text: Arab having second German car

parts.note: Audi is a German car maker

explanation.surface: An Arab owns a second car, a German model.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi is a native of Saudi Arabia, an Arab nation.

clue.text: Central European archdeacon tucking into black berry

indicators.note: tucking into means going inside, so the title goes inside the fruit

parts.note: the sloe is the dark blue-black fruit of the blackthorn
Ven, for Venerable, is the title abbreviation used for an archdeacon

explanation.surface: A churchman from central Europe is eating a dark berry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucking into' suggests eating; here it means going inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A Slovene is a native of Slovenia, a country in central Europe.

clue.text: Some leave when one's not at one's best?

definitions.meaning: a holiday from work, a day of leave

definitions.text: when one's not at one's best
definitions.meaning: a day when things go badly or one performs below par

explanation.definitionFit: An off day is a day of poor performance, and a day off is a day of leave.

clue.text: Topless dance to cause anxiety to old female relative

indicators.note: topless means the top, or first, letter of the word for dance is removed

parts.note: taken as written
to stress someone is to make them anxious

explanation.surface: A topless dance would surely upset one's grandmother.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancestress is a woman from whom one is descended, a forebear on the female side.

clue.text: Sports administrators note celebrity

parts.note: FA is the Football Association, which governs English football
me (or mi) is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Sports officials take note of a famous person.
explanation.definitionFit: Fame is the state of being celebrated, renown.

clue.text: Run by city, German one mostly, with one friend

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter of the word is kept

parts.note: Munich is a German city, the one picking up the city mentioned earlier
I is the Roman numeral one
pal means friend

explanation.surface: A city-run service is managed by a German and a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'German one' means a German city, the 'one' standing for the city just mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: Municipal describes what belongs to or is administered by a town or city council.

clue.text: Dropping off lemon scone that's cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests being prepared or worked over, so the letters of lemon scone are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone nods off over a freshly baked lemon scone.
explanation.definitionFit: Somnolence is drowsiness, the state of falling asleep.

clue.text: Carefully selected husband together with old Scotsman being mentioned

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogy and marriage records
and joins things together

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the word for an ancient Scot is heard as a word for chosen

parts.note: the Picts were an ancient people of what is now Scotland

explanation.surface: A husband was carefully chosen alongside an old Scot who was named.
explanation.definitionFit: Handpicked means personally chosen with great care.

clue.text: Hitch as concert featuring Elbow more than half over

indicators.note: featuring means including, so the concert word holds the turned letters

parts.note: a prom is a promenade concert, as at the BBC Proms

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the kept letters are read backwards
more than half means three of the five letters are kept, the first three

parts.note: taken as written: also the name of a British rock band

explanation.surface: A concert by the band Elbow hits a snag when it is more than half over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elbow' looks like a joint; it is the band. Elbow is a Manchester rock band; the Proms are a London summer concert season.
explanation.definitionFit: A hitch is a snag or difficulty, a problem.

clue.text: Nothing but a lake

definitions.meaning: a small lake or pond, a word common in northern English place names

explanation.definitionFit: Mere as an adjective means only or simply; as a noun it is an old word for a lake.

clue.text: Incantation alluring woman endlessly delivered

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter is removed

parts.note: a mantrap is slang for a seductive woman

explanation.surface: A spell is cast by a seductive woman, delivered without end.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantra is a sacred word or chant repeated in meditation or prayer.

clue.text: Eminence following leader of Eucharist taken by Catholic priest

indicators.note: following means the hill comes after the rest
taken by means held within, so the initial goes inside the Catholic abbreviation

parts.note: RC is the abbreviation for Roman Catholic

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter of the word Eucharist

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill or high point, an eminence

explanation.surface: His Eminence follows a Catholic priest leading the Eucharist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eminence' looks like a cardinal's title, but it means a hill. TOR is a rocky hilltop, as on Dartmoor in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A rector is a priest in charge of a parish.

clue.text: Light meal taken by singer-actress. Chips, perhaps?

indicators.note: taken by means the meal is had by the singer, so they stand together

parts.note: tea is a light afternoon meal
Cher is the American singer and actress

explanation.surface: A star of stage and screen has afternoon tea, perhaps with chips on the side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chips' suggests fried potatoes, but it is Mr Chips, the schoolmaster of James Hilton's novel Goodbye, Mr Chips.
explanation.definitionFit: Mr Chips is the fictional schoolmaster in Hilton's novel, an example of an educator.

clue.text: Harass peacekeepers boarding carrier

indicators.note: boarding means getting on or into, so the peacekeepers go inside the carrier

parts.note: a hod is a builder's trough for carrying bricks
the UN, the United Nations, deploys peacekeeping forces

explanation.surface: Peacekeepers getting on a transport are pestered.
explanation.definitionFit: To hound someone is to pursue and harass them relentlessly.

clue.text: Blue feathers

definitions.meaning: soft fine feathers, as used in pillows and duvets

explanation.definitionFit: Down means low in spirits, and it is also the fine soft plumage of birds.

clue.text: Terrible lapse — a bit of a bloomer

indicators.note: terrible suggests something gone badly wrong, so the letters of lapse are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dreadful slip, something of a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' looks like a blunder, matching 'lapse'; here it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A sepal is one of the leaf-like parts enclosing a flower bud, so part of a flowering plant.

clue.text: Excel at trick showing some beef

parts.note: overt means openly shown
rump is a cut of beef

explanation.surface: Someone excels at a trick, showing off some meat.
explanation.walkthrough: In card games such as bridge, to overtrump is to play a higher trump than one already played to the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtrump is to beat a trump already played, coming out on top in a trick at cards.

clue.text: Performing alone, Simon somehow obtains part in South Pacific

parts.note: solo means performing on one's own

indicators.note: somehow means in some unexplained way, so the letters of Simon are rearranged

parts.note: to land something is to obtain or secure it

explanation.surface: Simon somehow lands a solo part in the musical South Pacific.
explanation.walkthrough: 'part in South Pacific' suggests a role in the musical; it is a region of the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The Solomon Islands are a nation in the south-western Pacific Ocean.
